communication-01.semantic_alignment: a written or digital communication sent to someone

claims.proposition: Indonesian pesan and Malaysian mesej both commonly refer to a written or digital message, but their everyday meanings are not fully identical: pesan also commonly means an instruction or advice, while mesej is more specifically used for a message or news item.

communication-05.semantic_alignment: to respond to a message or communication

claims.proposition: Indonesian balas and Malaysian balas are common everyday choices for replying to a message; Indonesian membalas and Malaysian membalas are also used as fuller verb forms.

communication-07.semantic_alignment: a phone or internet call with live video

claims.proposition: Panggilan video is a clear term in both Indonesian and Malaysian Malay for a call with live video; video call is also commonly used in everyday speech in both locales.
